page.overview:
Who is Hiram Bish?

Hiram Bish was a Human male who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. He was a member of the Corellian Security Force before choosing to become a criminal.

Hiram Bish was once a member of the Corellian Security Force. However, by the time following the Battle of Yavin, he was part of the group of CorSec troopers and agents who left CorSec in pursuit of a more criminal lifestyle. Along with Mtara Vinram, Hiram Bish became one of the commanders of the Rogue CorSec. The spacer infiltrated the Rogue CorSec Base to find proof of the Diktat's innocence. Hiram Bish and Mtara Vinram were killed during the assault.

Hiram Bish appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts,

Hiram Bish was added to the game with the release of the "Publish 25," a.k.a. the "New Game Enhancements," on November 15, 2005. He was part of questline that featured the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat. as the questline was integrated into the "Legacy Quest," the main questline in the game.
